answer_1.quote: The ability to generate responses with consistent personas is important towards building intelligent dialogue agents.

answer_2.quote: We adopt multiple widely used metrics to measure the response quality, including Perplexity (PPL), BLEU, and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 200 samples from the test set for human evaluations. Five professional annotators from a third-party company were asked to rate the responses from three aspects: 1) Fluency (Flu.); 2) Coherence (Coh.) with the dialogue history, 3) Persona consistency (Pcon.).
answer_4.guideline: The instruction of human evaluation is given in Appendix B.
